methods.label: Compare changes over equal intervals
methods.explanation: The changes over the successive intervals are \(+3\), \(+6\), \(+4\), and \(-1\). From 8 to 10 h, the temperature rises by 6 °C, the greatest increase, and the line segment is steepest.
methods.levelReason: Comparing increases over equal time intervals uses elementary subtraction and trend interpretation within Grade 7.
